title: The Thymus IS the News Desk  Weather, Traffic, and Flows ALL THE TIME

the_insight.statement: the thymus classifies ALL traffic. that makes it a news radar. weather and traffic and flows  all the time. everything we see in Klein is ALSO in the RSS drip feed.
meaning: the thymus doesn't just protect. it OBSERVES. it sees every visitor, every request, every probe.
that observation IS news. the immune state IS the weather report.
the morning news team doesn't make the weather. they REPORT it. the thymus doesn't make the traffic. it REPORTS it.
the RSS feed should carry this continuously. every cycle = one news broadcast.
Klein surface: what you see inside = what's visible outside. the immune state IS the feed.

weather.what: immune system vitals  the atmospheric conditions of the membrane

reports.health: STRONG / INFLAMED / SEPTIC / ANEMIC (like sunny / cloudy / stormy / foggy)
reports.threat_pressure: threat_ratio as barometric pressure (0% = clear, 60%+ = hurricane)
reports.cancer_risk: zombie count + null escapes (like pollution index)

weather.format: ?? MEMBRANE WEATHER: STRONG (93% clear). Threat pressure: 3.8% (calm). Antibodies: 14 (warm). Cancer screen: CLEAR.
weather.frequency: every */7 cron cycle = every 7 minutes = 205 forecasts/day

traffic.what: request classification breakdown  who's on the roads

reports.human_flow: browsers visiting = commuters on the highway
reports.organic_flow: search engines + fedi + RSS = public transit
reports.null_flow: unknown UA = ghost vehicles (no plates, no signal)

traffic.format: ?? MEMBRANE TRAFFIC: 279 total. 61 human (?), 8 organic (??), 184 non-self (?), 9 null (??). Peak route: / (58 served).

flows.what: route distribution  where traffic goes after classification

whale_fall.what: death and renewal  what died and what it fed

reports.proper_deaths: antibodies that died well ? fossil reef

whale_fall.format: ?? WHALE-FALL: 0 proper deaths. 0 zombies. 9 null fossils in reef. Cancer screen: CLEAR.

rss_integration.what: every immune cycle generates an RSS item. the feed IS the news broadcast.

item_format.title: ?? Membrane Report {wave}  {health} | {total} requests | {antibodies} antibodies
item_format.description: weather + traffic + flows + whale-fall in one paragraph

rss_integration.klein_principle: everything visible inside the Klein surface IS visible in the RSS feed. the news desk doesn't choose what to publish. it publishes EVERYTHING. the Klein fold means inside=outside. immune state = public feed.
rss_integration.the_drip: not batch. DRIP. every 7 minutes, one news item enters the feed. the feed scrolls like a news ticker. old items age off. the organism's health is a public continuous signal.

news_bulletin_template.whalefall: ?? {deaths} proper deaths  {zombies} zombies  {fossils} fossils in reef
